purpose: General principles for authoring plan documents (plan JSON): structure, task granularity, dependencies, acceptance criteria, testing, traceability, and a severity catalog of violations, used when no project-specific rules exist.
summary: Plan definition: responsibility, temporary lifetime, and JSON format {feature}_plan.json
Task ID prefixes and priority ranges, where higher numbers mean higher priority
Plan structure limited to requirements_traceability, design_traceability and tasks, with mandatory requirement_ids
Task granularity rules and the principle of not copying implementation details from design documents
required_reading field specification: relative paths, strategy document, glossaries, empty array when none
Task groups with build_check values, grouping criteria, no compatibility code, and early verification validity
Dependency management with depends_on, parallelizable tasks, and implicit dependency patterns
Acceptance criteria norms forbidding subjective wording, and testing norms requiring unit tests in the same task
Traceability norms where no requirement may be left without a task
Severity catalog mapping each violation pattern to critical, major, or minor, plus additive feature plan detection
tasks: Splitting work into tasks and groups
Checking requirement traceability in a plan
Judging severity of plan review findings
title: 計画書 作成原則
